summary: We are looking for a detail-oriented SQL Developer Intern who is interested in working with databases and structured data. This role focuses on query writing, data extraction, and supporting analytics and development teams with reliable datasets.
responsibilities: Write and execute SQL queries for data retrieval and analysis
Assist in creating and maintaining database tables and schemas
Work with joins, subqueries, views, and basic stored procedures
Perform data validation and ensure data accuracy
Support reporting and analytics requirements with structured data
Maintain documentation for database logic and workflows
required_skills: Pursuing or recently completed graduation in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, or related field
Familiarity with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server
Basic understanding of data normalization and relational concepts
Analytical mindset with attention to detail
nice_to_have_skills: Willingness to learn and work on real-time projects
